join.title: Apne event ki photos dhoondho
join.hint: Code aapke QR card pe likha hai
welcome.consent: Button dabakar aap maante hain ki aapki selfie sirf is event mein aapki photos dhoondhne ke liye use hogi.
welcome.privacy: Aapki selfie search ke turant baad delete ho jaati hai
welcome.not_ready: Photos abhi add ho rahi hain. Thodi der baad aayein.
welcome.expired: Is event ki photos ab available nahi hain.
welcome.not_found: Event nahi mila. Code check karein.
selfie.title: Apni selfie lo
selfie.hint: Chehra gol ghere ke andar rakhein, achhi roshni mein
selfie.camera_blocked: Camera nahi khula. Neeche button se selfie lein.
photos.none_hint: Camera ki taraf seedha dekhkar, achhi roshni mein dobara try karein
privacy.title: Aapki privacy
privacy.p1: Aapki selfie sirf is event mein aapki photos dhoondhne ke liye use hoti hai aur search ke turant baad delete ho jaati hai.
privacy.p2: Ek event ka face data kabhi kisi doosre event ke saath share nahi hota.
privacy.p3: Galat photo pe “Main nahi hoon” dabayein, ya humse kahein ki aapko photo se hata dein.
privacy.p4: Plan khatam hone par event ki photos apne aap delete ho jaati hain.
err.no_face: Chehra nahi dikha. Achhi roshni mein dobara try karein.
err.multiple_faces: Camera mein sirf apna chehra rakhein
err.pin_wrong: PIN galat hai, dobara try karein
err.rate_limited: Bahut zyada koshish ho gayi. Thodi der baad try karein.
err.generic: Kuch gadbad ho gayi. Dobara try karein.
err.offline: Internet nahi hai. Connection check karein.
err.event_not_found: Event nahi mila. Code check karein.
err.search_expired: Session khatam ho gaya. Dobara selfie lein.
err.image_too_large: Photo bahut badi hai. Dobara try karein.
err.event_expired: Is event ki photos ab available nahi hain.
err.event_not_ready: Photos abhi add ho rahi hain. Thodi der baad aayein.
err.bad_image: Photo padh nahi paaye. Dobara try karein.
profile.save_title: Agli baar selfie ki zaroorat nahi
profile.save_body: Apna number save karein — jo bhi naye event aap jodenge, unki photos apne aap mil jaayengi.
profile.consent_body: Hum aapki photo nahi, sirf ek face code (numbers) encrypted rakhte hain. Yeh sirf un events mein use hota hai jo aap khud jodte hain. Kabhi bhi delete kar sakte hain.
profile.saved: Save ho gaya! Ab “Mere events” se photos milengi
login.title: Apna mobile number daalein
login.resend_in: {s} second mein dobara bhej sakte hain
login.privacy: Sirf OTP ke liye — koi password nahi, koi spam nahi
me.title: Mere events
me.empty: Abhi koi event nahi. QR scan karein ya neeche code daalein.
me.no_face: Face code save nahi hai. Ek selfie lein taaki photos apne aap milein.
me.delete_face_confirm: Face code aur saare matches delete ho jaayenge. Pakka?
me.shortcut: Meri photos dikhao — selfie nahi chahiye
me.none_yet: Abhi aapki koi photo nahi mili. Nayi photos aane par hum WhatsApp pe bata denge.

gallery.expired: Yeh link expire ho gaya hai
err.otp_expired: OTP expire ho gaya, naya mangaayein
err.otp_send_failed: OTP nahi bhej paaye. SMS se try karein.
err.gallery_not_found: Yeh link expire ho gaya hai
